welcome.banner: Welcome to Lynora! Add an account to send and receive email.
welcome.body:
Welcome to Lynora!

Lynora is a personal information manager for Debian-based distributions that brings email, calendar, contacts, tasks and notes together.

To get started:
  • Add your email account from File → Add Account (Gmail, Hotmail, Yandex, Yahoo and any IMAP/SMTP server).
  • Switch between Calendar, People, Tasks and Notes from the navigation bar on the left (Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+5).
  • Open .msg message files with File → Open or by double-clicking them.
  • Press F9 to synchronize all accounts and F1 to see keyboard shortcuts.

Enjoy!
